## Category 1: UI — Beginning Screen (6 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Beginning screen appears after partner joins
**Given:** Two users have joined a /live session
**When:** Both users are connected (meetingPhase transitions from 'waiting')
**Then:** Beginning screen displays with story/point picker instead of going directly to freeform verification
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — create session, simulate partner join, screenshot

### UAT-1.2: User's stories are listed
**Given:** User has stories in the database (from P117)
**When:** Beginning screen loads
**Then:** "YOUR STORIES" section shows user's stories with title preview, point count, and "understood" count
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — login as user with stories, join /live, screenshot beginning screen

### UAT-1.3: User's points are listed
**Given:** User has points in the database
**When:** Beginning screen loads
**Then:** "YOUR POINTS" section shows user's points with text and position buttons (Disagree/Unsure/Agree)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — login as user with points, join /live, screenshot beginning screen

### UAT-1.4: Search filters stories and points
**Given:** User has multiple stories and points
**When:** User types in search field
**Then:** Stories and points are filtered to match search query (client-side)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — type in search, verify list updates

### UAT-1.5: "Speak freely" option is visible
**Given:** Beginning screen is displayed
**Then:** "Speak freely — no topic selected" button is visible at the bottom
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot showing the button

### UAT-1.6: Session history panel shows verified cards
**Given:** User has completed a verification in the current session
**When:** User returns to beginning screen
**Then:** Session history panel shows verified card with checkmark and rating
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete one verification, return to beginning screen, screenshot

## Category 2: Navigation (2 tests)

### UAT-2.1: returnTo param changes back button text
**Given:** /live is opened with `?returnTo=/events/test-event`
**When:** Session is active
**Then:** Back button shows "← Back to event" instead of "← End session"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — navigate to /live with returnTo param, screenshot header

### UAT-2.2: returnTo param navigates correctly
**Given:** /live is opened with `?returnTo=/events/test-event`
**When:** User clicks "← Back to event"
**Then:** User is navigated to `/events/test-event`
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — click back button, verify URL is `/events/test-event`

---

## Category 3: Data Integration (3 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Stories fetched from database
**Given:** User is authenticated and has stories
**When:** Beginning screen loads
**Then:** Stories are fetched via `getStoriesByAuthor(userId)` and displayed
**Verify:** Chrome DevTools MCP — check network tab for Supabase query, verify stories match DB

### UAT-3.2: Selected story synced to session
**Given:** User selects a story for verification
**When:** "Does [partner] understand?" is tapped
**Then:** `selectedStoryId` and `selectedStoryVersionId` are saved to `clarity_sessions` row
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — query `clarity_sessions` table, verify columns populated

### UAT-3.3: Partner sees selected story card
**Given:** User A selects a story for verification
**When:** User A submits their rating
**Then:** User B sees the story card with "How confident are you..." prompt
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — simulate both users, verify partner view shows story content

---

## Category 4: Error Handling (3 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Empty state when user has no stories or points
**Given:** User has no stories and no points
**When:** Beginning screen loads
**Then:** "Speak freely" is shown as primary option with hint: "Create stories to verify next time"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — login as new user with no content, screenshot beginning screen

### UAT-4.2: Simultaneous selection resolved
**Given:** Both users are on beginning screen
**When:** Both tap to select content at the same time
**Then:** First selection wins (by DB timestamp). Second user sees "Partner selected a story" and becomes responder
**Verify:** Manual test with two browsers — both click simultaneously, verify only one selection persists

### UAT-4.3: Invalid returnTo URL ignored
**Given:** /live is opened with `?returnTo=https://evil.com`
**When:** Session loads
**Then:** returnTo is ignored, back button shows default "← End session"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — navigate with external returnTo, verify back button text is default
